stem.text: The height of the peak of the curve in a Boltzmann distribution represents the number of molecules that have the most probable energy.
A sample of gas has its temperature decreased without changing the number of molecules present.
Which statement correctly describes a feature of the Boltzmann distribution for the gas when the temperature decreases?

A.text: The value of the most probable energy would stay the same.

B.text: The number of molecules with the most probable energy would increase.

C.text: The area under the molecular energy distribution curve would decrease.

D.text: The number of molecules at the very high energy end of the distribution would stay the same.
